newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo aluminium futures score solid gains.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo aluminium futures score solid gains.

text.p: Tokyo yen-based aluminium futures scored solid gains on Thursday on strong buying triggered by the metal's firm performance in London overnight, traders said.

"We've seen fresh buying as well as stop-loss buying as the contracts breached psychological resistance at 195 yen," said one trader. "Sentiment is strong, though we might see a breather as the market's rise seems overdone."
The June contract gained 4.7 yen to finish at a contract high of 197.0 yen, while the April added 4.1 yen to end at 197.6 yen. Others were up between 3.3 and 5.0 yen.

In London overnight, the benchmark three month climbed $27 to end at $1,642, helped by tightness emerging in September dates and good borrowing of the August/September spread. Flagship copper fell $27 to $2,273. -- Tokyo Commodities +81-3-3432-6179
